title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. translated_title: 通过记忆摆脱潜在陷阱：面向世界模型规划的无训练情景核排斥方法
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通过最小化预测潜变量与目标潜变量之间的距离来向目标图像进行规划。然而这种距离并非测地距离：它在墙后、角落和死胡同中存在局部极小值，即“潜在陷阱”，而无记忆的滚动时域重规划会使智能体持续被困其中，不断重访远离目标的状态。我们提出情景核排斥，这是一种无需训练的代价项，通过针对智能体实际访问过的潜在变量所构成的新颖性门控记忆库，利用 top-k 高斯核对候选计划进行惩罚，并根据当前基础代价进行重新缩放，使其强度在不同模型之间具有可比性。在两个 JEPA 世界模型和四个基准测试上，在相同的模型、规划器和预算条件下，EKR 将平均成功率从 31.8% 提升至 46.7%（LeWM），从 54.7% 提升至 64.0%（H-JEPA）。相同记忆下的反事实实验表明，在大多数设置中，EKR 会将规划推向远离已访问状态的方向，在导航任务中往往以更高的基础代价为代价；卡住的情形……
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的情景核排斥代价项，利用智能体已访问潜在状态的新颖性门控记忆惩罚候选计划，帮助世界模型规划摆脱局部极小值“潜在陷阱”，在两个JEPA世界模型和四个基准上将规划成功率显著提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalizes candidate plans against a novelty-gated memory of visited latents, enabling world-model planners to escape "latent traps" (local minima) and substantially improving planning success rates across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks.
